Use case: stylized-concept. Production environment plate for My Panaderya, PHASE 1 environment only. REFERENCE ROLES: All attached input images are STRICT references for ILLUSTRATION AND RENDERING STYLE ONLY. Copy their graphic rendering grammar: clean simplified polygonal forms, bold deliberate outlines, crisp cel-shaded light/midtone/shadow planes, high-contrast edges, playful slightly exaggerated proportions. DO NOT copy their workshop subject, characters, tools, logos, layout, blue/red/purple color palette, or writing. Warm bakery reinterpretation with cream #FFF0D2, caramel, milk-tea brown, warm wood, dusty blush/pink #D77F98, dark cocoa/plum-brown outlines #4C2B3C, selective sunny gold accents. No green. Distinct color separation and assertive dark shadow blocks. Modern polished 2D GAME BACKGROUND ART, near-vector cel animation aesthetic, NOT a painterly illustration or realistic interior. No grain, woodgrain, canvas texture, brushwork, realistic material rendering, airbrushing, ornate trim, arches, rustic/antique objects, people, food, gameplay UI, text or watermark. Large flat color regions and angular graphic highlights; selective very subtle gradients only in light emitters. Most shadows MUST have hard cut edges.

Left24% width empty wall reserved for future packages; center52% width dominant empty contemporary wall reserved for future expanding food showcase; right24% width empty wall reserved for future tickets. Central usable wall x24%-76% fromy14%-80%, approximately square-ish. All 90-degree geometry: simple rectangular recess with substantial straight cocoa structural posts at x23% and77%, slim cream edge highlights, bold angular shadows. NO rounded arch, no ornamental framing. Center cream wall surface with tasteful sparse geometric rectangular/stepped square patterns in pale blush and warm light cream, slightly inset wall seams, subtle asymmetric color blocking near outer corners; keep the entire central area empty and quiet yet attractive. Pattern is architectural surface decoration, NOT food-card placeholders or a grid of cards.
Side walls in contrasting dusty blush and warm milk-tea, simple clean rectangular wall panel seams, broad flat cel shadows. Below sidewall at y60%-80% a few large flat warm-wood panels with cocoa silhouettes and clean peach edge highlights (NO visible woodgrain). Clean modern squared ceiling/cornice, warm brown plus deep cocoa shadow strip across very top. Two minimalist cream-and-gold square box pendant fixtures with thin straight stems positioned above side areas at x12% and88%, light at y18%-24%. Crisp geometric pools of warm light on wall, no hazy glowing wash. No hanging greenery, antique lamps, carved timber or decorative moldings. NO shelves or racks of any kind yet.
COUNTER: Continuous modern counter/table spanning ENTIRE screen width across bottom20%. Its BACK EDGE MUST be horizontal at EXACTLY80% of image height. A cream quartz/laminate countertop plane y80%-85%, thick flat cocoa outlined rectangular edge at y85%-87%, small golden rim highlight. Counter front at y87%-100% uses large flat milk-tea wood panels with a few warm blush rectangular inset color blocks and cocoa vertical seams, strong cel-shaded lower shadow. NO carvings, floral tiles, ornate cabinet doors, realistic texture, curved bullnose, or floor. Counter top EMPTY, no register (separate sprite).
Keep lights and architecture visually dimensional using just2-3 flat colors per object with crisp dark outlines and edge highlights, match graphic energy of references but keep warm bakery palette. Bright clean cream focal wall, substantial deep brown/plum shadows, blush creates color variety. Avoid washed-out beige and dominant orange/gold. Absolutely no food, packages, shelves, display cases, glass displays, menus, ticket boards, buttons, icons, labels, lettering, UI panels, people or other foreground elements.
